biotools.summary: AFDB-Cluster provides a representation of protein structural clusters derived from the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database (AFDB) and other datasets, facilitating analysis of protein structure-function relationships. The resource offers a way to explore the shared functional landscape across diverse protein data sources.
